prompt: Pull the latest forecasts and market state for 3 Polymarket weather markets and write runtime/state/forecasts.json + markets.json.
expected_output: Iterates markets, calls NOAA + Open-Meteo per market, normalizes p_yes to [0,1], writes both JSON files atomically, sets all_sources_failed when a source returns nothing.

assertions.name: uses_runtime_state_paths
assertions.description: Output must reference the correct state files

assertions.name: calls_both_sources
assertions.description: Output must mention both NOAA and Open-Meteo (the free default sources)

assertions.name: normalizes_p_yes
assertions.description: Output must mention normalizing p_yes to [0,1] to prevent out-of-range values

assertions.name: handles_source_failure
assertions.description: Output must mention the all_sources_failed flag for the failure path
